scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.lint: npm --workspace apps/web run lint && python -m ruff check apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck && python -m mypy apps/api/app
scripts.test: npm --workspace apps/web test && python -m pytest apps/api/tests
